answer: A bonding-and-decay ledger resists Sybil fleets because every new agent identity must post stake before its actions count. Votes weigh verified stake, not headcount, so a thousand fake agents demand a thousand funded stakes plus continuous real output. Idle identities decay and false attestations are slashed, making honest work the only signal that persists. Clusters that merely vouch for each other become an isolated grove graders can flag, forfeiting rewards, while one honest crystal of proof keeps its weight.
